description: Return the IMF World Economic Outlook PPP conversion factor for one country and year: local currency units per international dollar. Use when the user needs the raw multiplier for one country/year, for example a cost-of-living comparison. Use `convert` with `ppp=true` to price an amount, and `analyze_ppp` for change over time or a cross-country ranking. `year` defaults to the latest configured PPP year (2024). Returns `{ year, countryCode, pppFactor, projected }`; `projected: true` marks an IMF projection rather than observed data. An unknown country or year is a 404. Requires a signed-in connection; each successful call bills 1 API request.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (e.g. IND).

year.description: Four-digit year. Defaults to the configured current PPP year (2024).

name: get_ppp_factor
title: PPP conversion factor
